title: AI Stock Soars 460,000%: Thiel's Big Bet & Anthropic's $350B Valuation — 2026-01-19
description: In today's episode, we dive into Peter Thiel's strategic move of selling Nvidia and Tesla shares to invest in an AI stock that has skyrocketed by nearly 460,000% since its IPO. We also explore Anthropic's ambitious $350 billion valuation target, as Sequoia Capital joins the funding rounds. Plus, OpenAI's revenue hits $20 billion, but what are the hidden costs of such growth? Tune in for these stories and more at https://aisimplify333.github.io/Daily-ai-News/listen/. Stay updated with the latest in AI and tech news!
